DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P21G01..P21G08 = cols 216-223, identical to ES3032 line 20 and to the questionnaire's column codes (216)-(223)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 11 sets item = the variable name (p21g01..p21g08; lower-casing is Stata naming in the .do, a mechanical case change of the CIS code) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P21G01..P21G08 match the 8 rows of the Pregunta 21g grid in cues3032.pdf character for character, 8/8 (the questionnaire's line-break hyphenations 'espec-/táculo' and 'im-/presiones' rejoined; the questionnaire is a scanned image with no text layer, so it was read from a 300-dpi render, not OCR). item_text is that shared wording. VALUE LABELS identical on all 8: 0 'N.P.' 1 'Todos o casi todos los días' 2 'Una o dos veces por semana' 3 'De vez en cuando' 4 'Casi nunca o nunca' 7 'N.P.' 9 'N.C.', matching the questionnaire's numbered list and show card P (which prints the same four in capitals: 'TODOS O CASI TODOS LOS DÍAS' ...). option_text uses the questionnaire/value-label casing. The .do recodes 0, 7 and 9 to missing, so resp {1,2,3,4} and option rows ship for those four codes only. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisive: reading DA3032 (2464 records, all 385 bytes; id = row number) at cols 216-223, dropping 0/7/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 254 and cov_age cols 255-256 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 6756 rows both, 870 live ids, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex stored in the live table as the Stata value label (1 -> 'Hombre' 3140 rows, 2 -> 'Mujer' 3616 rows, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/3/4): p21g01 754/57/47/8, p21g02 383/83/139/208, p21g03 43/58/436/297, p21g04 485/153/171/44, p21g05 285/130/195/242, p21g06 159/151/275/246, p21g07 555/145/118/29, p21g08 351/142/189/178 -- every item uses all four levels. Dropped by the .do: code 0 1580 on every item, code 7 5/24/15/7/6/15/9/3, code 9 13/47/35/24/26/38/28/21 (p21g01..p21g08). Live values read from the local irw cache copy table_context.R had just written (~/.cache/irw); validate_items.R --table-sets passed (8 items, resp {1,2,3,4}). STRUCTURAL MISSINGNESS: P.21g is asked only of respondents who live with a child ('A QUIENES CONVIVEN CON HIJOS/AS (1 en P.21)') and, per the interviewer instruction 'SI EN P.21c CONTESTA QUE TODOS/AS LOS/AS HIJOS/AS CON LOS QUE CONVIVE TIENEN MÁS DE 25 AÑOS, PASAR A P.22', whose co-resident children are not all over 25. In DA3032 code 0 (N.P.) covers all 790 P21=0 (no children, P.20), all 585 P21=2, all 3 P21=9, plus 202 P21=1 respondents -- consistent with the over-25 skip. Code 7 ('N.P.') is not printed in the questionnaire grid (only 1-4 and NC 9); read as item-level not-applicable, dropped by the .do either way. So per-item n is 813 (p21g02) to 866 (p21g01) of 870 live ids (884 respondents not coded 0), and missing cells mostly mean not asked. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the Pregunta 21g stem verbatim from cues3032.pdf, shared by all 8 grid rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section. DEVIATION disclosed: the interviewer direction '(MOSTRAR TARJETA P).' at the end of the stem is not read to respondents and is not shipped; the filter headers and interviewer routing are likewise not shipped. The stem's 'solo' is printed without accent in the source and kept so. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3032 in Spanish only (questionnaire, codebook and show cards checked, no English); the _translated columns are English written by this project -- issues-page line owed at upload. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, irw#2381, every CIS survey year) applied, not re-derived; originator confirmed CIS (questionnaire header 'ESTUDIO 3.032' on the show cards, and ES3032/FT3032 are CIS's own). Not an instrument-name mismatch: the dictionary description (eating together, homework, shows, TV, playing/sport, chores, talking, walks with the children) matches the 8 P.21g rows in order.
